name: smooth-scroll
title: Smooth scroll
description: Optional eased, inertial scrolling for the page or one box, on Lenis, that never fights the browser: scrollbar, Page keys and anchors still work.
docs: Wrap the app once for page scrolling, or wrap one box with root={false} and give it a height. It eases the wheel only, and turns itself off on touch screens, under reduced motion and when enabled is false; scrollTo then falls back to a plain jump, so a button that calls it never goes dead. It lets go when the scrollbar, Page Down or an anchor takes the scroll mid-ease, pauses while a dialog locks the page, and leaves nested scrollers, menus and dialogs alone; mark any other area with data-lenis-prevent. Do not combine it with CSS scroll-behavior: smooth or scroll snap on the same scroller. Use one page-level provider, and read scrollTo and active with useSmoothScroll.
